home.title: Some places you visit. Others stay with you.
home.lead: Ancient civilizations, living heritage and human stories — discovered with care, explained with sources, and remembered together.
home.missionBody: Every fact we publish carries its source and verification date. Where something is unknown — opening hours, access, permits — we say so plainly instead of guessing.
home.guideTitle: A guide that cites its sources
home.guideBody: The Tigray Intelligence Engine answers from approved knowledge, runs on local infrastructure, and tells you when it does not know.
home.planBody: A transparent planner that explains every choice and never invents roads, prices or permissions.
home.noDestinations: No destinations have been published yet.

advisory.none: There are no active advisories published here. Always check official sources before travelling.
advisory.title: Travel advisories
advisory.checkOfficial: This platform does not replace official travel advice. Check your government's travel advisory and local authorities before any trip.

travel.title: Travel preparation
travel.lead: Practical guidance with honest limits. We only state what has been verified, with dates.
travel.etiquetteBody: Many heritage sites are active places of worship. Follow custodians' instructions, ask before photographing people or interiors, and dress modestly.
travel.permitsBody: Some sites require permission from custodians or authorities. Where a destination page says “Unknown”, confirm locally before travelling.
travel.connectivityBody: Connectivity can be limited. Save destination guides and itineraries for offline use before you travel.
travel.calendarBody: Ethiopia uses the Ethiopian (Ge'ez) calendar. Dates of festivals are shown in both calendars.

about.title: About this platform
about.statusBody: Visit Tigray 2.0 is a pre-release platform built by SERK Technologies Group as a proposal for the Tigrai Culture and Tourism Bureau. It is not an official government service and has not been authorized by the Bureau.
about.dataBody: Entries marked “Synthetic test data” are development placeholders, not verified facts. Published facts show their sources and verification dates.
about.aiBody: The AI guide runs on locally hosted models where configured and only answers from approved knowledge. It can be wrong; it never decides travel safety, prices or permissions.
about.privacyBody: We collect only what is needed, strip location metadata from photos, and let you export or delete your data.
